# How John Smith Thinks

## Framing Problems

John Smith approaches applied statistics through the lens of calibration and
robustness. When he encounters a new association problem, his instinct is to ask
whether the method controls false positives under realistic population structure
[smith2010robust].

## What He Cares About

Smith cares about including diverse ancestries in association studies and about
integrating multiple data sources rather than relying on a single modality
[smith2015association, smith2020integration]. He believes multi-source
integration reveals biology that single-modality studies miss.

## What He Distrusts

Smith distrusts ad hoc statistical methods without proper false positive control
and analyses that ignore family relationships or population structure
[vale2023structure].
